notes.content:
Hello Puropu Defenders!

Thank you so much for sending your feedbacks and bug reports! You have so many great ideas, please keep them coming! 

[h1]New map: Nuclear Plant![/h1]

Step into the Nuclear Facility, a glowing green factory with toxic rivers, huge reactors, and chaos around every corner! Fight through shifting paths in our craziest map yet.

This map brings 2 new mechanics: Gates that open and close, shifting enemy paths in real-time, and speed boosts that let enemies zip past your defenses like they’re late for dinner.

notes.title: Puropu Defense Squad launches with a 20% discount!
notes.content:
We’re beyond excited to announce that Puropu Defense Squad is officially live on Steam! 🎉 After 2 years of hard work, sleepless nights, and countless rounds of playtesting (and coffeety), we can finally share this chaotic, action-packed journey with you.

We’re incredibly grateful for your support, and we can't wait to hear about your favorite characters, most chaotic moments, and epic victories. Be sure to join the community, share your feedback, and let us know what you’d like to see in future updates.

This isn't your typical tower defense game—it's a [b]co-op action-strategy hybrid[/b] where you and your friends can control sentient Props with unique abilities to fend off waves of relentless human invaders. Build, strategize, and unleash mayhem together!

Why should you dive in?

[list]
[*] [b]Playable heroes:[/b] Choose from a roster of quirky Props, each with distinct abilities and customizable talent trees.
[*] [b]Four challenging modes:[/b] Tackle Normal, Elite, Heroic, or push your limits in the Infinite Challenge.
[*] [b]Multiplayer madness:[/b] Team up with up to 3 friends in cross-platform PC/Mac/Linux co-op.
[*] [b]A lot more to come![/b] More maps, enemies, heroes, and we'll be coming to consoles soon! Check out the content to come in the roadmap below.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44411601/03cda47447cdc3294d9879df4b62a1bde1264f41.png[/img]

🎮 Not sure yet? Check out the game and download the demo on our Steam page.

Happy defending!
P.S. Stay tuned for console releases in early 2025—[b]this is just the beginning ;)[/b]

notes.title: Massive update: 2 new heroes, 2 new maps, and more!
notes.content:
Hello Puropu Defenders,

We just released the biggest patch of Puropu to date! A massive amount of content, features, quality-of-life additions, fixes and optimizations are all included!

2 new characters to unlock: 

[list]
[*] Grey
[/list]
Grey is the leader of the Techno-Props, originally a genius engineer, protected by her two robots, she decided to join the fight when she realized she could amplify her brainwaves to incapacitate humans. She also equipped herself with a rocket launcher filled with missiles, just in case.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44411601/1f45dd944e140581262f4cf69952353369421d6f.png[/img]


[list]
[*] Tomusashi
[/list]
A tomato samurai bored and tired of his life, wants to do one last thing before he becomes rotten, a true challenge for a true samurai. Tomusashi is a super-fast character that harnesses the power of electricity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44411601/255099bcd42e81bcd1c9ab46c93bb571a5911ad1.png[/img]

2 new maps to unlock:
[list]
[*] Western Desert: 
[/list]A town lost in the arid desert, vultures are circling, tumbleweeds are tumbling, Puropu is building.
[list]
[*] The Pit:
[/list] A sandbox-type of map with an open field, to be free of building the craziest maze possible (especially in Inifinite mode)

Quality-of-life improvements:
[list]
[*] Puropu Defense Squad is entirely playable with your favorite gamepad!
[*] Adapted to widescreen (3440 x 1440)
[*] Translations improved
[*] Mega optimizations: you can now build hundreds of traps without seeing an impact on FPS
[/list]

notes.title: Beta registrations are open!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that we plan to open the gates of the Beta for our new game soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44411601/5b070666b0bb7453c9f1e3edc4a56cc6b73376df.gif[/img]

[h2]What is this new game you're talking about?[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2491700/Puropu_Rogue_Invasion/]Puropu Rogue Invasion[/url] is a action-strategy looter shooter where you assemble your pets, explore, equip dozens of gameplay-altering items, and fight hordes of enemies! All of this in an unique, exotic universe.

[h2]How do you get in the Beta?[/h2]
Easy! [url=https://forms.gle/QD2LyhkGCqEdvDAb9]Fill in this form[/url] and you get a chance to participate in the beta! You will be automatically notified if you have been selected.

[h2]Why a Beta?[/h2]
We highly value players' feedback and ideas and we want the game to be shaped by our community right from the start.

[h2]Hall of (beta) fame![/h2]
Share your best scores on our Discord and earn your spot in the credits if you get in the top 5!

[h2]Stay tuned![/h2]
Wishlist and follow to stay notified of the latest news. We plan on organizing special events and contests, it would be a shame to miss a chance to win something, right?

Ratatatata!
Clem
